game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks, barracks half buried in snow: the firewood keeper must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Library Builder: Combine small functions into a reusable library the firewood keeper calls throughout the level.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks: barracks half buried in snow
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowdrift Barracks, repeat each round: Combine small functions into a reusable library the firewood keeper calls throughout the level. Each round, winter bandits strike the beacon fire, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the library value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the beacon fire from winter bandits in Snowdrift Barracks: keep the library meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: library drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Library Builder
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how library changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Snowdrift Barracks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while library > 0.
